use_when.text: Put it directly under a Table, at the same width.
Use First on page 1 and Last on the final page, so the matching arrow is disabled.
Use Middle for every page in between.
Set an arrow to Hover through its nested instance to show the pointer over it.
Update the summary range on each page, such as Showing 9–16 of 192 reports.

dont_use_when.text: Do not use it for lists that fit on one page.
Do not use it on mobile. Load more items as people scroll instead.
Do not use Pagination Arrow on its own outside Pagination.
Do not hide the summary when people need to know how many items there are.
Do not recolour it outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Keep the page size the same on every page, so the range in the summary stays predictable.
Return people to the same page when they come back from an item.
